backend/main.mo: Motoko backend implementing user profile management, access control, runbook storage, and troubleshooting session lifecycle.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files and their roles in the application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, base styles, and light/dark mode color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application configuring routing, theming, and route-level authentication.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access‑denied message with a button to return to the homepage.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication wrapper that handles login status, profile setup gating, and loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button that toggles Internet Identity login/logout with loading indicators and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog prompting first‑time users to enter and save their profile name.
frontend/src/components/history/HistoryF: Renders search, status, and category filters for history listings with controlled inputs and select menus.
frontend/src/components/intake/CategoryP: Displays a grid of selectable issue categories using a sprite-based icon sheet.
frontend/src/components/intake/SymptomQu: Shows a list of checkbox symptoms based on the selected category and manages selection state.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Provides the top navigation bar with app branding, navigation buttons, and login/user display.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps pages with a header, footer, and main content layout container.
frontend/src/components/session/QuickAct: Displays a guided quick action with command copying, instructions, and outcome submission.
frontend/src/components/session/RunbookS: Renders step-by-step troubleshooting runbooks with completion handling and optional quick actions.
frontend/src/components/session/SessionO: Provides actions to mark a session resolved or escalate it, including an escalation summary dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity, invalidating queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status states. Includes helper functions to create the AuthClient with custom options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, sessions, and session-related actions via an actor API. Automatically invalidates relevant queries after mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes. Applies global background, text, and border styles.
frontend/src/lib/clipboard.ts: Implements a cross‑browser clipboard copy utility with fallback for insecure contexts. Returns success status as a boolean.
frontend/src/lib/recommendation.ts: Selects the best matching runbook for a category and symptom list by scoring symptom overlap. Falls back to the first runbook if none match the category.
frontend/src/lib/runbooks/catalog.ts: Defines interfaces for runbooks and exports a catalog of troubleshooting runbooks with steps, symptoms, and quick actions. Used for session guidance and recommendations.
frontend/src/lib/sessionFormatting.ts: Formats timestamps into relative time strings or a short date. Converts nanosecond timestamps to readable output.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge to create merged className strings. Helps avoid conflicting Tailwind classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that initializes React, sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, and renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx: Renders the user's session history with filtering, search, and loading states. Displays session cards or an empty‑state message when none match.
frontend/src/pages/SessionDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a troubleshooting session, including runbook steps, timestamps, and status. Handles loading, error states, and escalation/resolution actions.
frontend/src/pages/StartIntakePage.tsx: Renders the issue intake form that collects category, title, symptoms, and notes, then starts a troubleshooting session and navigates to it.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, required features, assets, and metadata for the self‑healing IT support app.
